items.text: Puka Nacua is active despite calf injury and limited/no practice Friday; confirmed by multiple sources after GTD/optimism tag.
items.why: Berry confirmation; Rapoport and Schefter official active reports; McVay called calf minor.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1/2; reverse any bench plans or backup elevations for Rams WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route/target share expected vs Raiders.

items.text: Breece Hall officially inactive vs Dolphins after GTD/pessimism and Rapoport 'unlikely' report; misses fourth straight with quad.
items.why: Schefter actives/inactives list; Rapoport sources earlier Sunday morning.
items.implication: Continue committee/lead role for backup RB; Hall ramp continues toward Week 8.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps/targets for Jets RB2 in favorable matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR Sunday morning injury summary after questionable designation earlier in week.
items.why: ETR weekend reports summary; ankle injury context from prior practice reports.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB starts; Flowers and Ravens pass-catchers face downgrade risk in volume/efficiency.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT per ETR summary (Smith hamstring, Wicks ankle); impacts PHI pass game especially with Hurts also sidelined for MNF.
items.why: ETR weekend reports; corroborated in injury trackers for Monday PHI-DAL.
items.implication: Heavy target concentration on remaining PHI pass-catchers; Goedert and any elevated WRs surge in opportunity.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets/red-zone for Dallas Goedert and depth WRs.

items.text: Adam Levitan thinks Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain, despite Rapoport sources expecting him to resume lead back role vs Texans.
items.why: Levitan post-game/injury watch comment; ETR listed Skattebo/Tracy hamstring watching.
items.implication: Monitor snap share closely; possible committee or reduced efficiency if playing through.
items.opportunity: If limited, Tracy or other Giants RBs gain.
items.conflict: Rapoport expected lead back vs Levitan injury suspicion; Berry also HATE on Skattebo matchup.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY in ETR summary after hamstring return-to-practice; Berry notes efficient prior games and great DAL matchup if active for MNF.
items.why: ETR classification; Berry Love/Hate context on efficiency and matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start if confirmed active; PHI run game reverts toward early-season usage.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN after awaiting green light; returns from layoff per ETR and Rapoport notes on field return.
items.why: ETR IN list; Rapoport Packers notes.
items.implication: Resume lead RB role but Berry fades post-layoff rust/workload questions vs DET.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on Jacobs post-layoff vs ETR IN and expected volume.

items.text: Berry strongly advocates rostering Jonah Coleman 100% of leagues as future Broncos RB you wish you had; ETR listed him IN after IR designation return.
items.why: Prior production (13 touches/TD) plus Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency; ETR activation.
items.implication: Add for handcuff/upside in DEN backfield; stash ROS.
items.opportunity: Potential committee expansion or lead if others struggle.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide but Levitan says almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if self-inflicted while not scoring.
items.why: Levitan direct reply to ETR injury watch list including Gibbs ankle.
items.implication: No major downgrade expected for upcoming; continue elite RB usage.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad) returned to game per ETR late Sunday injury watch; no long-term concern flagged.
items.why: ETR watching list notes returned to game.
items.implication: Maintain elite RB1 status; monitor next practice for any setback.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES A.J. Brown Week 7 for usage/matchup vs CHI (WR10 rank in Love list); back in real role with Bears allowing yardage.
items.why: Usage rebound and favorable Bears secondary matchup in Love/Hate.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with target/route upside.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets and yards vs soft coverage.

items.text: Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft vs DET (TE6) as Lions TE defense is a buffet allowing multiple high-scoring TE games and TDs.
items.why: Matchup exploit: Lions allow high TE fantasy points and TDs.
items.implication: TE1 upside start in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and intermediate targets vs vulnerable DET TE coverage.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32) due to likely Gonzalez shadow on outside routes where 90% of targets come; limited upside history.
items.why: Tough CB shadow matchup and outside-target concentration.
items.implication: Sit/flex fade; look elsewhere for WR depth.

items.text: Berry LOVES volume RBs Jaylen Warren (@NO RB9), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB RB10), Bucky Irving (@CAR RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent/high snap-carry roles vs defenses carved by RBs.
items.implication: RB2/flex starts with floor from volume.
items.opportunity: Carries, third-down, potential goal-line in positive scripts.
